Yesterday you interrogated a table that behaved itself. Today you meet one that does not, and
you spend the whole day with it.

Day 4 owns three sentences. The **missing-data sentence** decides what to do about the holes.
The **string-cleaning sentence** tidies text so that comparisons work. The **derived-column
sentence** adds the column that holds your answer, which is almost never one of the columns in
the file. Functions arrive this morning, because by last night you had written the same line
three times and felt why they exist.
